# every construct this corpus shares, used correctly
#   Cast         Laila
#   Variables    trust number 0..100 · late flag
@scene Library · now | fade 900
@set trust = 30
@label hub
@router
- trust >= 50 -> warm
- else -> cool

@label warm
Laila (neutral): She looks up.
@jump choose

@label cool
@when late
Laila (neutral): The lights are already off in the stacks.
Laila (neutral): She does not look up.

@label choose
? What now  [mark]
- Say nothing -> ending [set late = yes]
- Ask her -> ending

@label ending
@end Done [key done]
